author: Kitima
description: One window with tabs for Datacat, JanitorAI, Chub and RisuRealm: browse each site's Trending, Popular and Latest bots. JanitorAI bots go to Datacat, which builds and imports the card; Chub and RisuRealm bots import straight into SillyTavern. Also freezes or hides Datacat Browser's dancing top-bar cat.
